description: Phase B (local file access): grant the REMOTE web UI loaded from https://chat.bioclaw.tech the minimal dialog + read-only fs permissions it needs to let the user pick local files/folders and upload their bytes into the current chat's server workspace. Scoped via `remote.urls` to the chat.bioclaw.tech origin ONLY — Tauri APIs are NOT opened to arbitrary origins. Read-only: no fs write/create/remove permissions are granted. The fs scope is intentionally broad ($HOME/** plus drive roots) because the user picks arbitrary paths through the native dialog; Tauri v2 does not auto-add dialog-selected paths to the fs scope the way v1 did, so a broad read scope is required for user-chosen files to be readable.
